title: Best Pull-ups for BACK SIZE (Demon Back Bodybuilding Exercises)
summary: NH demonstrates his three favorite pull-up variations for back hypertrophy: wide-grip fat-grip pull-ups, cupped close-grip chin-ups with a 'banana' path, and neutral-grip towel pull-ups. Changing grip and implement lets you do frequent, heavy pull-ups without overuse injuries while also training the forearms.
claims: Doing lots of loaded pull-ups eventually brings tendinitis and overuse issues; varying grip and implements lets you keep doing them often
Wide-grip fat-grip pull-ups: choose the widest comfortable grip that keeps lat tension, to maximize stretch with a shorter range of motion
On pronated pull-ups put grip pressure on the outside of the hand and the pinky; wrapping the thumb shifts the work to the arms
Do not descend past the point where the lat is maximally stretched; going lower adds nothing on wide grips
On the wide fat-grip pull-up the torso naturally shifts toward the bar, making it a sternum-style pull-up
Without fat grips, use a thumbless grip for the same benefit
Do not let a small muscle like the forearm dictate the work of a big muscle, though fat grips make the back work harder
The lat is the main muscle in chin-ups even when done arm-dominant, so chin-ups alone will not build big biceps
For certain lat development the chin-up is superior to the pronated pull-up
Cupped close-grip chin-ups: cup the fat grip, press down and in with the top fingers with wrists slightly over and inside, letting the body travel forward in a banana-shaped arc
Do not fully extend the arm at the bottom of cupped chin-ups
Cupped chin-ups need thoracic mobility; lacking it, people overextend the elbow and risk biceps injury
Open the ribcage and let the head go between the arms, like opening the knees to sit into a squat
He has almost stopped doing normal chin-ups in favor of cupped chin-ups
Never use a false grip on chin-ups, because pressure goes to the fingertips and you can slip
The square top frame of a Smith machine is ideal for cupped chin-ups without fat grips
Neutral-grip towel pull-ups: grab the towels high, wrap and lock the wrist; pressure goes around the thumb; towels allow deeper scapular stretch and heavy forearm work
Pull the slack out before every pull-up, as you would before a deadlift; starting loose ruins form and recruitment
Drive the elbows down as if tearing your hands from the towels; the more the torso leans back sternum-style, the more lats you recruit
He neglected his back for years, started retraining it about two years ago, and regrets the gains he lost
The pull-up is the best vertical pull in existence; start unloaded then add weight
exercises: widest comfortable grip; pressure on pinky side; scapular retraction; stop at max lat stretch
maximizes lat stretch, prevents arm pulling, trains forearms
cup fat grips, press down and in, banana path, no full extension
comfortable cupped grip without fat grips
grab high, lock wrist, drive elbows down
grip strength, forearms, deep scapular stretch
